## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated automated tests.
- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] I updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` when appropriate.
- [ ] I did not commit `main.js`, private vault data, or generated test vaults.
- [ ] The change preserves fixed node positions outside Initialize, Refresh,
      and Renew.
- [ ] The change adds no telemetry, runtime network access, remote code,
      advertisements, or automatic updater.
